result.summary: The application interface appears generally stable and well-aligned, with no significant functional or major visual layout defects detected based on the provided screenshot.

issues.description: The 'Popular right now' section title appears slightly cramped against the card above it, suggesting a potential margin consistency issue.

issues.description: The discount tag '-20%' on the bottom pizza card is partially cropped or positioned very close to the top-left edge of the card container.
